title: Zero-Downtime Database Schema Migrations
learningObjectives: Apply Expand and Contract (Parallel Run) migration pattern
Safely rename and split database columns in active production systems
Add NOT NULL constraints and foreign keys without locking large tables
keyTradeoffs: Dual-writing in application code vs database triggers during transition phases
Immediate column deletion vs gradual deprecation lifecycle
commonPitfalls: Running ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with volatile defaults on millions of rows
Deploying new application code before verifying backwards-compatible database schema
transferPrompt: How do schema migrations differ when tables are horizontally sharded across multiple database clusters?
